history.notes: Mid-week removal is correctly refused before any write (b23 fix holds for that case). Fails for (b)/(c). lib/listingRuns.ts bookedDatesDropped() matches existing blocks to the new recipe BY startDate and skips any block with no match ('A block whose run disappears entirely is closed, not deleted' — l.141-145).
